description: Users report various playback issues including crashes, getting stuck on loading screens, and inability to control playback accurately.
Users complain about intrusive advertisements and negative impacts from recent UI updates, such as random song playback or removal of controls for non-subscribers.
Users complain that recent updates have restricted basic music player features, forcing users to pay for premium access to functions like selecting songs or skipping freely.
Users note issues regarding missing songs, inconsistent lyric availability, and unwanted recommendation features.
Users are experiencing problems logging into their accounts, including password rejection and being unable to access the account.
A user reports that the offline download feature is not functioning correctly.
